hook: Water-based zinc and aluminum iodine batteries run four-electron iodine chemistry without halogen salts
hook_turn: run four-electron iodine chemistry without halogen salts
summary: Four-electron iodine conversion stores more energy but usually needs corrosive halogen-rich electrolytes. A designed mix of polar, kosmotropic, and nucleophilic species stabilizes the reactive iodine cations through halogen bonds. Shown in lab cells, so cycle life and scale-up are open.
title: Non-halogen aqueous electrolytes for four-electron iodine conversion.
